prompt:

Remove the blue photovoltaic CELL FACES from BOTH banks, leaving exactly TWO EMPTY low rectangular graphite/cream support FRAMES in the same positions, with open interiors and narrow structural braces but NO blue completed cell surfaces. Do not remove the two physical support structures or add a third bank. Open the single small control box by omitting its roof/front cover, leaving its unfinished empty casing.
Keep three fitted grey floor plates; remove ONLY the FRONTMOST fourth floor plate, revealing genuine transparent space with two narrow graphite X braces inside the complete original floor perimeter. The floor opening must be truly transparent between braces, not a painted black surface.
Keep cream/silver trim, navy/graphite unfinished hardware, upper-left light and the EXACT original shallow floor projection. Entire subject, every corner and all frames remain within the generous original transparent margins. No completed coupling, cargo, fuel tank, Core hub, service machinery, craft, crane, extra equipment, text, labels, symbols, axes, ground or external shadow. ONE complete isolated fixed view, no sheet.
